correctness.rationale: Enumerated exactly 1344 Latin completions with first row fixed, yielding 161280 uniquely labeled squares after 120 symbol permutations. The explicit cyclic and noncyclic representatives have computed isotopy stabilizers 100 and 12, generating disjoint orbits 17280 and 144000 which exhaust all squares. All four noncyclic intercalates map by recorded even isotopies; the even-isotopy orbit has size 60^3/12=18000 and is switch-closed. BFS reaches precisely 18000 nodes, proving it is a full connected component. Its H-equivariant transitive action means BFS eccentricity 13 equals diameter. A second complete 161280-vertex adjacency traversal finds 17280 isolates, eight 18000-vertex components, four parity types occurring twice each, and degree 4 on the mobile set. All loops are finite and exhaustive; the standalone included verifier returns VERIFY_OK.

Jacobson–Matthews 1996 DOI 10.1002/(SICI)1520-6610(1996)4:6<405::AID-JCD3>3.0.CO;2-J abstract proves connectivity under a broader family of proper moves, not intercalates alone.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general proper-move ergodicity theorem does not imply intercalate-only connectivity or exact diameter. Four parity classes give only a coarse lower bound: the present graph has eight nontrivial components. The 2004 quotient collapses each entire 144000-element noncyclic isotopy class, so its known two quotient vertices cannot dominate the labeled classification.

value.rationale: This is the first nontrivial odd order of a canonical and extensively studied Latin-square local-trade graph, not a cherry-picked subset. The full labeled state space is essential for transition and sampler irreducibility questions. The eight equal vertex-transitive components reveal a genuine extra twofold obstruction within each classically invariant parity signature, invisible in Wanless’s order-five isotopy quotient, and establish a complete exact transition diameter 13. The new geometric structure is motivated by local switching and is not a textbook algebraic count alone.
